# lab monitors

<!-- Generated by `lab docs` from the commands' own help (cli/build.sh). Do not edit by hand:
     change the command's help text in cli/ and rebuild. -->

```text
Add zaphod's network monitors (llama-swap, Open WebUI, MLflow, SearXNG, ..., chat over HTTPS, 1.1.1.1) to
Beszel. Asks for your Beszel login; the password is only sent to the local hub. Safe to run again:
existing targets are skipped. Good result: one line per monitor, "added" or "already there".
```

Usage:

```
lab monitors
```
